publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Franchising has been proved to be a successful commercial pattern in practice, but research on this form of network organization is still behind of practice. This paper first summarizes existing literature on franchising and points out that these theories are based on GHM model. The distribution of the power in the GHM model is based on physical assets. The critical resources in franchising are intangible assets, such as brand, so the GHM model as the basis of the research on franchising obviously has limitations. This paper, based on the R-Z model, begins by analyzing externality issues of specific investments in franchising, then constructs a framework for the analysis of the governance of franchising. We show that three different governance patterns are corresponding to three kinds of situations respectively: internal delegation, external delegation and dual delegation, which will provide the governance of franchising with appropriate theoretical foundations.

articleTitle: The Causes of Excess Liquidity and Macroeconomic Policy Choice in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Excess liquidity has become a one of the main macroeconomic problems facing China today. In this paper, the author comprehensively described the excess liquidity problem in China and analyzed the causes using Granger causality test methods. The research found that the cause of excess liquidity is the imbalance of macroeconomic both internally and externally. From internal factors, excess liquidity is the result of the continued growth of exports and the trade surplus; while from internal factors, the excess liquidity is the result of low domestic consumption demand. Since the trade surplus and domestic economic structural imbalances can not be effectively solved in the short term, to solve the problem of excess liquidity, the government must implement the domestic consumer demand based macroeconomic policy and supplemented it with the development of financial market strategy.

articleTitle: Study on Relationships among Compensation Model, Psychological Contract Fit and Organizational Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Using data of 128 employers and 526 employees from 20 companies, the paper studies the relationships among compensation model, psychological contract fit and organizational effectiveness, based on the review of the past research about compensation and psychological contract. Results show that the obligation fit between the employer and the employees in the employees' psychological contract affect the relationship between compensation model and organizational effectiveness significantly. Furthermore, compensation model moderate the psychological contract fit between the employer and the employees and intention to turnover significantly. At last, the paper discussed the implications of the study and the directions for future research.

articleTitle: A Study of Supplier Selection and Quality Strategy Based on Quality Costs Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Quality costs theory was used to analyze the interaction between quality of supplier and quality of intramural produce system, which affect the quality of final product and quality economy of enterprise. Analysis results revealed that incremental loss caused by quality of supplier will decrease with falling of oneself quality level; Total procurement costs varies with increase of the probability of quality defects caused by suppliers, but how to vary and which quality level is best depends on minus result of the price of per qualified product and the influence coefficient of quality level to quality costs. Thus, intramural quality should also be considered when selecting the quality level of supplier to avoid pursuing supplier for high quality product with blindness.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Hedge Ratio and Hedge Effectiveness of Soybean Futures in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to examine the risk hedging function of Chinese futures market at different developmental periods, this paper chooses soybean futures as the proxy and divides the series of its spot and futures prices from 1996 to 2005 into three stages based on the principle of ordered sample clustering. Through ADF test, structure break test and cointegration test, ECM model is then successfully established to compute and compare hedge ratios and hedge effectiveness of soybean futures at different periods. In the end, we get the conclusion that risk hedging function of soybean futures was remarkably reinforced after 1998 and along with the time passing by, reached a higher level after 2002. This change further reflects that the political regulations and innovations towards futures market between 1998 and 2002 have obtained fairly good effect.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Regional Brand Collaborative Construction from the Perspective of Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Industry clusters are one of drives to develop the regional economy. But in some regions the industry clusters are shortage of motivation. Many experts and scholars on how to promote the long-term development of a cluster proposed ideas and suggestions. Based on the previous research results the paper presented a study from the perspective of regional brands for the long-term development of industrial clusters. Moreover the construction of regional brand as an important issue was researched in the paper. During the research the paper introduced the idea of collaborative competition and used the collaborative mechanism to construct the regional brand. To achieve the purpose of the study the paper established a model of game and analyzed the conditions of collaborative construction the regional brand using the model. Combining with the conclusions from the model the paper proposed the measures to promote the collaboration to construct the regional brand.

articleTitle: The Solution to Acquire Application Ontology Based on Prolog
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A new framework to do requirements practices is formed, according to the Meta-ontology, domain ontology, application ontology and their interrelationship, which can help to do enterprise modeling and even build up its knowledge-oriented intelligent model repository. The consistency between the process of acquiring application ontology for users and the test on model competency is also analyzed. The frame based on ontology has a logic foundation of predicates description, which facilitates the simulation of how to acquire the application ontology on enterprise domains with AI language of Prolog. The language has the ability of logic reasoning to find the faultiness of domain ontology and then makes it improved and perfect, which also is a try to evaluate and maintain the domain models.

articleTitle: Dynamic Portfolio Analysis Based on Time-Varying Risk Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Dynamic portfolio is often utilized to disperse the time-varying risk in financial market. Under the frame of mean-variance analysis, we derive the dynamic portfolio policy. The optimal solution to dynamic portfolio are based on the time-varying risk, which is estimated by two volatility models, including multivariate GARCH model and realized covariance matrix. In empirical research, the effects of dynamic portfolio are compared with those of static portfolio, and the two volatility models are compared also. Empirical results show that dynamic portfolio is obviously superior to static portfolio, and the realized covariance matrix is appreciably superior to the multivariate GARCH model.

articleTitle: The Residential Districts Evaluation Model Application of Harmonious Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Aiming at these problems of the free of large area specifically for residential districts at present and the residential districts not meeting the market, the paper analyze the earlier stage planning process of residential districts systematically at the position of the housing developers, apply harmonious theory in the planning and evaluation of residential districts, analyze the harmonious theory deeply, find the way that how to apply the harmonious theory from analyzing the characteristic of exploitation of residential districts, analyzed the various factor which impact the price of the residential districts, include the inside function structure of housing district, outside environmental effect, the culture connotation and element of marketplace, set up the theory of analyzing the harmony of the residential districts, to provide the new intentional direction and set up the perfect evaluate system.

articleTitle: On Dynamic Partial Adjustment of Corporate Capital Structure: Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The basic divergence of modern capital structure theories is whether corporate capital structure converges to a target capital structure. Chinese listed companies have more characteristics that are different from other foreign firms. So we put forward our research hypotheses by relating various theories to Chinese listed companies' reality. Based on Chinese listed companies' panel data and dynamic partial adjustment models, the study finds that from the dimension of company cross section and time series: Chinese listed companies partially adjust their capital structure towards a target capital structure; these companies' adjustment cost is quietly lower and the adjustment speed is higher; the explain ability of pecking order theory and market timing theory is weak; and the stock price volatility effect on capital structure is temporal, it would be adjusted soon after.

articleTitle: Research on Relational Contract of International Operation of the Extroversive Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the theory of relational contract as the focus point, this paper expounds four internationalized operation strategies of enterprises, such as the spot merchandise imports and exports transaction, producing abroad, packaging and supplying relationship as well as the localization. The four strategies have their specific range of application and condition separately. The government and nongovernmental organizations supply and improve system environment of the enterprises continuously making for the enterprises improve their expectation of the markets. Therefore the internationalized operating strategies of enterprises result in the dynamic evolution, which can reduce the efficiency loss from the various trade friction and increase the social welfare continuously.

articleTitle: Estimation of China's Productive Capital Stock from Information Technology Investment: during the Period from 1980 to 2003
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: One of the important issues focusing on information technology on China's economic growth is to capture the flow of the IT capital services from cumulative IT capital stock of past IT investments. IT capital stock in China has not been published at present, and there has been scarce research on estimating this type of stock for its investment data availability. This makes it impossible to carry out further research on IT contribution to China's economic growth. This paper challenges the problem by estimating China's IT productive capital stock during 1980-2003. By estimating China's IT wealth stock in the same period, this paper adds our understanding of cumulative patterns and growth trend of IT productive stock in China. Another contribution of the paper is that we have constructed price indices for investment of IT assets based on the method called 'harmonized deflator', which has not been investigated in China previously. We used the price indices to deflate nominal investment in IT assets to estimate both IT productive stock and IT wealth stock. Our results indicate that IT productive stock has been accumulated much faster than IT wealth stock has done, while both of them have been rising sharply in China since 1980.

articleTitle: Enterprise Investment and Financing Decisions under a Stockholder-Bondholder Conflict Based on Real Option
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the modern companies the managers are often on behalf of the interests of the stockholders. The purpose of the investment decision is equity-maximizing but not value-maximizing, so the stockholder-bondholder conflict exits. This paper examines the impact of a stockholder-bondholder conflict over the overinvestment behavior and optimal capital structure choices using real option method, in order to explain the investment and financing decisions in the firm. We obtain the unlevered firm investment model - the value of levered firm model - and levered firm investment model. Based on the assumption that the investment is financed by the debt and the firm has no other assets before investment, so the project risk is high after investment than before investment. Numerical solutions show that stockholders are inclined to overinvestment, and choose to exercise the investment option too early and have the incentive to choose riskier investment projects, which affect the firm value and optimal leverage choices, do harm to the interests of bondholders. This model can give an explanation for the firms' overinvestment behavior, especially for the listed companies in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mobile Data Service Value Chain Based on Two-sided Markets Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, due to the rapid evolution of communication technology, the mobile data service is a newly emerging and rapid developing segment. Waning ARPU pushes the telecommunication operators to search for other sources of income. Mobile data services were expected to foster Industry growth. As to the brilliant prospect for data services, many industries expect to join this arena. The mobile commerce value chain is then formed. This paper analyses the major players that form part of the mobile data industry value chain. The network platform of mobile data services platforms play crucial roles on this value chain. In this paper, we figure out that the mobile data services market is a typical two-sided market. And we use two-sided markets model to fit the mobile data service value chain. To explore the cooporation in the value chain and suitable price policy what promote the mobile data service developement, we review the experience of NTT DoCoMo. As a result, this paper point out the members of value chain should work together and the mobile operators acting as the core mobile platform owner, should perform suitable price policy to unleash the potential of mobile data service.

articleTitle: Analysis of Supply Chain Contract Clauses on Supplier Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This article focuses on the systemic analysis of supply chain contract clauses on supplier flexibility and consequently puts forward a supplier selection approach for downstream buyer based on supplier flexibility from the perspective of risk sharing in supply chain. Firstly, it illustrates hierarchically supply chain contract clauses to orchestrate: (1) five specification parameters, which comprise supply price per unit (P), order cycle time (T), minimum delivery lead-time (L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub>), minimum order quantity commitment (Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">min</sub>) and maximum order quantity limitation (Q<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>), and (2) three penalty parameters, which consist of delivery lead-time violation penalty (α), order quantity reduction penalty (β) and order quantity increasing penalty (γ). And then, based on the flexible supply chain can be defined as an entity with little constraints of order quantity and delivery lead-time, it focuses on the quantitative analysis of measurement for supply chain flexibility (Ψ). The analysis reveals that (a) the supply chain flexibility consists of two parts that is lead-time flexibility and order quantity flexibility, (b) the value of the supply chain flexibility (Ψ) is close to 1, that means the upstream supplier flexibility is robust. Alternately, as the value of decreases nearly to zero, which means the upstream supplier flexibility is rigid, (c) from the perspective of risk sharing, Ψ equal to 1 means the upstream supplier bears on the whole risk while Ψ equal to 0 means the downstream buyer holds on the whole risk in supply chain. Further, it emphasizes that the supply chain contract, which comprises all parameters mentioned above, is a result of negotiation between the downstream and upstream parties to guarantee both coordination and a win-win outcome. It essentially reflects the extent of risk sharing of the both parties and flexibility of the upstream supplier. When many suppliers are available, the downstream buyer must select the one with the greatest flexibility and the least overall cost. Finally, it depicts the least overall cost model, which comprises three parts: (1) component pricing, (2) order quantity violation penalty, and (3) delivery lead-time violation penalty.

articleTitle: Demand Analysis on Engines of Iron and Steel Industry Output Growth
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper is devoted to empirical analysis of some major demand factors that impact on steel industry between 1999 and 2006, based on VECM. The result of cointegration test shows that there is long-term equilibrium relationship among real estate industry, relative downstream industries, steel exports and steel industry. When the sales of real estate industry, relative downstream industries and steel exports increased 1%, will make steel output rise by 51.4%, 34.5% and 13.2% respectively; Meanwhile, although real estate, relative downstream industries and the steel export have different degree impacts on steel output, they are positive; The result of variance analysis also shows that real estate will play a major role, and steel exports will play a minimum role on steel output fluctuations.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Allocation in the Cooperative Game of Overflowing Infrastructure Investment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: As is well known, infrastructure is very important to people's living and manufacturing activities. And infrastructure investment has become a big deal that related the healthy development of town's society and economy. The investment of infrastructure with high operational-degree can be realized through marketization. However, for infrastructure with low operational-degree, government is always its investment subject. Especially for overflowing infrastructure with low operational-degree, governments will take the countermeasure to invest in the overflowing infrastructure together usually to satisfy each administrative region's demand. Because of this kind of infrastructure has less or even no cash flow, so it may be much proper to substitute "investment" with the word "cost" here. In the process of investment cooperation, there exists game between governments around the allocation of investment viz. cost, and the relation between governments is cooperative game. In face of unbalanced requirements levels, in order to promote the realization of overflowing infrastructure investment, how to allocate cost among governments that participating in investment effectively? This paper answered this question. Firstly, the paper provided the basic statement of cost allocation problem. On the basis of analyzing several cost allocation methods of cooperative game, chose NSCG method based on separable cost and inseparable cost as the cost allocation method of this paper. Then, put forward the process of cost allocation deeply by using NSCG method based on separable cost and inseparable cost. At last, the paper simulated the application of this method in the cooperative game of overflowing infrastructure investment through an example. We hope the research will benefit the practice.

articleTitle: A Whole Information Method to Establish the Dynamic Early Warning Mechanism for Real Estate Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: A new technical method to establish the dynamic early warning mechanism for a real estate enterprise is put forward. In the method, a dynamic quantitative early warning information estimating model about quantitative factors is put forward through establishment of three state transition equations to describe normal development, development speed and development inertia respectively; based on the equations, the dynamic scale forecast of each input, output and structural factor is made using the fading memory variable coefficient grey forecast model, CARMAX and Kalman filtering forecast method respectively; a dynamic qualitative early warning information estimating model about qualitative factors is put forward using CIA to calculate the cross influence degree between each pair of qualitative factors and using the system simulation and MCI to calculate the cross influence probabilities of qualitative factors. A comprehensive evaluation model about the quantitative and qualitative early warning information is put forward. The whole mechanism is applied to solve the problem of how to make out future developing strategies when a real estate enterprise faces changeable outer environments.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Arbitrary Alteration of Financing Capital Input Destination by the Listed Firms in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper studies one hundred and eighteen listed companies that have announced alteration of financing capital input destination in 2004 as research subjects, collecting related financial data of the year before alteration, the year of alteration and the year after alteration of these companies. The paper is to adopt the method of paired samples t test to study how the alteration of financing capital input destination influences the performance of the listed company. Researching conclusion indicates that the alteration of financing capital input destination has negative effects on profitability, credit capacity and the growth ability; but the influence of the alteration of financing capital input destination to the asset management ability has not been verified. Finally, the paper proposes a few suggestions to standard the using of the financing capital of the listed companies because the alteration of financing capital input destination has negative effects.

articleTitle: Research of College's Scientific Research Management Workflow Model Based on Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Taking the process management of scientific research project as the research object, this paper analyzes management activities of Scientific and Technology Department in colleges, and establishes the business process conceptual model of it. Petri net, because of its solid mathematical foundation and graphical character, is more preferable than other analysis tools available for workflow. So it is adopted by this paper to establish the workflow model. Then, this paper introduces the notion of WF_net (workflow net) and the method of modeling workflow. Through analyzing the management activities of Scientific and Technology Department in colleges, the workflow model based on Petri net is established. After that, this paper introduces the definition of correctness offered by Aalst, presents an algorithm based on it to check the correctness of the WF_net. So these researches can give some helps to the development of information system of scientific research management.

articleTitle: Comparative Research of Portfolio Model Using Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: By discussing both linear and nonlinear fuzzy situations, we give the relevant model and the solution method. First of all, regarding the target level of investment return and investment risk as the half trapezoidal fuzzy number, we give the fuzzy portfolio selection model of linear satisfaction degree. Then, to describe the investor satisfaction degree of investment return and investment risk better, a logarithmic membership function has been imported. Following, we give the fuzzy portfolio selection model of nonlinear satisfaction degree. Nonlinear optimize model can be transferred to linear programming model, so that model calculation has been simplified significantly. Finally, according to the actual data of Chinese securities market, both of models have been compared by using genetic algorithm. Result indicates that portfolio selection model based on linear and nonlinear membership function includes not only historical data, but also investors' expectation. That accords with human psychology and fact. However, by adopting the nonlinear membership function and adjusting its parameter, it can furthest get portfolio that accords with investor's expectation. Therefore, nonlinear membership function is better than linear membership function.

articleTitle: The Determinants of Credit Card Customer Loyalty: An Empirical Study in a Chinese Context
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Customer loyalty has been the focus of marketing research in the past decades, and it is generally recognized that the key to profitability is more likely to involve the retention of current profitable customers and increasing their spending than in trying to win new customers. However, the conceptualization and measurement of customer loyalty in credit card marketing, especially in a Chinese context, has not been addressed, nor does the development and empirical validation of customer loyalty determinants model. Based on theoretical literatures review, this paper proposes a comprehensive set of constructs and hypotheses that has been compiled with a methodology for testing them. The questionnaire was created in order to measure the determinants including commitment, switching cost, customer satisfaction, and perceived value. Then data were collected from more than 1000 credit card customers of a commercial bank in China, which were analyzed by using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) techniques. Based on the influencing intensities of the determinants of customer loyalty, further discussions have been put forward and the research implications and limitations as well.

articleTitle: Brand Extension Strategy Evaluations Based on Consumer Perception
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Brand marketers are looking for ways to expand their portfolios, meanwhile decrease the costs of the new products introduced as well as diminish the risk of new product failure, in order to win and survival in an ever more rising competitive situation. Brand extension, which is to put a new product created in another category under the name of an existing brand, is one of the most popular ways to achieve this. However, the brand owners must realize that brands are one of the most precious assets and need to be managed with care and deliberation when deciding to extend the brand. If this strategy can be evaluated based on consumers' perception before putting it into practice, it will be one of most secure way. This study intends to find out how to evaluate brand extension strategy based on consumers' perception. Based on related literature review, mainly focus on the factors related to brand extension, it explicates the research hypothesis, then design questionnaire which including a 2*2 study (four brand extension proposals), the questionnaire survey used to collect consumer's evaluation and the sample size is 150. The thesis illustrates how to analyze survey data by using duplicate measurement variance analysis. The thesis concludes with results and findings of the analysis performed which the authors hope will help brand marketers in improving their market strategies.

articleTitle: Quantity Flexibility Contract Design in Supply Chain under Adverse Selection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The problem of quantity flexibility contract design is studied in the setting that the downstream retailer's marginal cost is his private information. In a two stage supply chain system which contains a single supplier and a single retailer, the distortion of low cost retailer's order quantity and the impact on profit of the supply chain caused by asymmetric information are analyzed using the analytical framework of contract theory. The tradeoff relation between information rent extraction and efficiency loss is obtained and the second best quantity flexibility contract under adverse selection is designed. The contract increases the supplier's expected profit and the efficiency of the supply chain by reducing the high cost retailer's order quantity and paying information rent to the low cost retailer. The results of numerical analysis confirm the conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on the Regional Grade Structure of Small and Medium Sized Cities under the Interaction of Purchase and Businesses Operation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The establishment of business units influenced by city residents shopping journey is mainly formed on the basis of residents' journey flow for different commodities in accordance with the availability of the commodities and the traffic convenience. At the same time, Businesses management must be aware of the effects of urban regional structure on their economic benefits and make correct decisions of the location of business units Therefore, the process of urban regional economy development is a dynamical coordinated process between the buyers and the sellers within the region. The article takes Anyang City for example to illustrate how the distribution of all kinds of commercial centers is determined by the interaction between purchase behavior and businesses operation in small and medium sized cities.

articleTitle: Solving the Stochastic Location-Routing Problem with Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Location-routing Problem is a kind of hard combinatorial optimization problem arose in supply chain and logistics system. The deterministic location-routing problems in which all data are known in advance have been researched sufficiently, and the conventional method of solving the deterministic problems is to divide the problems into location-allocation problems and vehicle routing problems. The stochastic location-routing problem which is much closer to the real case is researched in this paper. In the stochastic problem the demands of the customers follow a certain random distribution. A genetic algorithm is designed to solve the stochastic location-routing problem. Novel genetic represent and corresponding genetic operations are designed in the genetic algorithm so that the location-allocation and vehicle-routing can be tackled simultaneously. Local search is also applied in the algorithm in order to improve the search effectiveness and the solution quality. Simulations based on numerical examples show that the proposed algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Insurance Accurate Calculation Method of Option Pricing Submitting to Jump-Diffusion Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces a new method of option pricing which is insurance accurate calculation. It is to deal with the problems of option pricing under the unbalance, arbitrage existing and incomplete circumstance. Meanwhile this paper transforms option pricing into a problem of equivalent and fair insurance premium. This approach is valid even when arbitrage exists and market is incomplete and unbalanced. It is proved that subject matters with saltant price like agricultural product can be priced well by pricing model of jump-diffusion process, and in this paper, "abnormal" fluctuate of price is described by renewal process which is more general than Poisson process, and jump-diffusion price model is based on it, and its renewal interval is described by the Γ distribution.

articleTitle: Performance of Currency Hedging across Major Stock Markets under Different Constraints
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The performances of currency hedging across major markets under different constraints are compared, using method of mean-variance portfolio selection. The test results show that the hedging performance changes in different economic areas. For instance, it performs better in European markets, especially when the investor has high risk appetite, but has not significant advantage in Asian markets, especially in Asian emerging markets. In addition, constraints imposed on currency hedging affects the performance significantly while the constraints on asset short sell does not. It is denoted in the test that no constraint in hedging position or the constraint is limited to total position does not affect the performance severely, while more strict constraints, such as keeping short position in each currency future account, will reduce hedging performance greatly.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Analysis of RMB/USD Exchange Rate after the Exchange Rate Reform in 2005
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The nonlinear local technique is used to test the nonlinearity of RMB/USD exchange rate after the exchange rate reform in 2005, and three models are used to forecast RMB/USD exchange rate. After the exchange rate reform, the exchange rate of RMB/USD is more fluctuant than before, which makes the forecast of the RMB/USD exchange rate more and more important in the research area and in practice. In order to test the nonlinearity of the exchange rate, the surrogate data methods are put forward and the results indicate that RMB/USD exchange rate has nonlinear predictability. The forecast performances of the three models on the RMB/USD exchange rate show that the nonlinear one order weighted local method is more precise than the ARIMA model and ANN models.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Medicine Industry Cluster Networks in Harbin under the Networks View
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this work, the development process of the clusters was described on the view of social and enterprise network to Harbin's medicine industry clusters. In addition, the condition and development characters of the industry clusters were described. Further, the resistance and impetus during the development of the industry clusters were revealed. According to the metrology method, the network density of the Harbin's medicine industry clusters and the effect of the central degree in the local network on the growth of the enterprise were analyzed by UCINET software.

articleTitle: B2C E-Commerce's Customer Relationship Management Based on the Long Tail
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of computer technology and network communications technology, e-commerce has a rapid development on a global scale. B2C e-commerce as a new shopping channel, because it has characteristics of providing sufficient information, breaking time and space boundaries, low-cost and real time, has rapid development. As a channel for transactions, B2C e-commerce also needs to be supported by appropriate customer relationship management (CRM). So e-commerce companies need to do customer segmentation based on their value, and then take appropriate customer relationship management strategy. The long tail, as the basis of a new business model, emphasizes the value of sporadic demand and small customers. In this paper we propose a new customer value model in the new economic environment based on the long tail and then offer corresponding customer relationship management strategies.

articleTitle: Organizational Structure and Technological Innovation: An Empirical Study in Chinese Automobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In a competitive global market with rapidly changing markets and particular customers, technological innovation (TI) is a major requirement for business success. Little empirical study has examined the relationship between organizational structure (OS) and TI performance. Based on the literature of TI and OS, this study explores the effects of OS variables upon TI success in Chinese automobile firms. This study considers five dimensions of OS, such as, hierarchical layers, locus of decision-making, the degree of formalization, internal boundary and external boundary with customers and suppliers. A research framework is built to examine relationships among the five aspects of OS and TI performance in Chinese automobile industry, and a contingency approach is taken by examining the moderating effects of firm size. Multiple regression results show that the layers, formalization, internal and external boundary dimensions have significant influences on TI performance; whereas locus of decision-making hasn't significant influence on TI performance. Subgroup analysis reveals that these main effects, but hierarchical layers by way of an exception, are moderated by firm size.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Organizational Management and Advanced Manufacturing Technology: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This study draws from the advanced manufacturing technology (AMT) theory and explores the effects of organizational management on implementation of AMT. Three most important characteristics of organizational management, managerial flexibility, organizational size, and supplier management ability are identified. And AMT system is further classified into three categories, manufacturing technology, devising technology, and administrant technology. Based on literature review of the relationship between AMT and the three characteristics of organizational management, three hypotheses regarding such relationship are proposed. The hypotheses are tested among 709 manufacturing enterprises using data collected from International Manufacturing Strategy Survey (IMSS) database 2005. The result supports our hypotheses that organizational management has overall positively effects on AMT, while the effects of each characteristic of organizational management on each category of AMT are inconsistent. The empirical investigation of the relationship in this study provides insight to both academic world and manufacturing industry, especially to the Chinese business management activities.

articleTitle: Research on Supplier Multistage Evaluation Considering Discount Rate
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the increasing importance of building partnership in supply chain, it is more important for core enterprise to evaluate suppliers in the long run multistagely. Considering discount rate, the paper researches the group decision-making method of AHP multistagely, brings forward the concept of weight-vector with discount rate (WVDR) and the concept of synthetical weight-vector with discount rate (SWVDR). More, the paper brings out a concept of consensus degree and a frame of interactive decision-making with consensus degree for supplier multistage evaluation considering discount rate. In the end, an example of supplier evaluation is offered and the result is satisfactory.

articleTitle: System Analysis Model for Core Attractiveness of Tourist City
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Attractiveness is very important to tourist city and knowing what is the most attractive factor in tourist city is the key to improve the tourist city competitiveness. This paper analyzes the complex system problem of how to identify the core attractiveness of tourist city, defining the index of core attractive factor of tourist city from the point of view of economics and strategic management by the method of system analysis and pointing out that the index of the core attractiveness of tourist city has the characters of durability and uniqueness. On the basis of this, we development the system analysis model identifying the core attractiveness by improving the method of ELECTRE I (elimination et choice translating reality). A case study on a city in China is given to illustrate the availability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: A Study on the Performance Evaluation of Construction Project Integrated Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the integrated management system of construction projects, quality, schedule and cost are an entia in which they influence and restrict each other, and the change of anyone of the three objectives can induce the changes of the other two. So, how to make the performance evaluation of construction project integrated management objective and equitable, and provide a feasible reference benchmarking for integrated dynamic control, is a problem that should be studied carefully. Most previous project management performance evaluation method mainly adopted the single item linear analysis method. This method is easy, but can not reflect the complicated non-linear interaction between the evaluation indexes. In the light of the merit of BP artificial neural network method, the authors established a construction project integrated management performance evaluation model, which is based on the BP (back-propagation network) neural network, considering project time limit, quality requirements, cost, three major factors on construction project integration management. The analysis of a practical example shows that the evaluation results are more overall, scientific and objective.

articleTitle: Study on Difference of Regional Housing Price Bubble in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With rising of housing price in regions such as Shanghai, Beijing and Hangzhou, the question of "Is there any regional real estate bubble in China" is much debated by the academic and the practise circles without any last word up to now. In this paper, panel data model, based on assets value determining theory, where major factors influence housing price is analyzed in the way that basic housing price shall be explained by basic macro-variables and bubbles in housing price by expectation in rising of price, is used to identify the bubble in regional housing price in China, it is obvious from the positive study that housing price of most regions rise reasonably in China in year 2003 and 2004, except few regions such as Shanghai, Zhejiang and Gansu, but since year 2005, except regions such as Neimenggu, Helongjiang, Jiangxi, Hunan, Guizhou, Gansu and Ningxia, where housing price is in a safe increasing range, most regions in China have experienced over-hot in housing price to some extent, especially in Zhejiang, Beijing and Shanghai, where bubble is over than 30%, which shows the bubble trend varying obviously with passing of time, and even if it is analyzed in the same period, the difference is also distinct in different regions, from which, it is recommended that local government shall adopt pertinent measures to control regional housing price.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Gray Correlative Analysis in Evaluating of Financial Risks of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the market economy, the financial risk that the enterprise faced is becoming increasingly diversification and complication, and the influence also deepen increasingly. Researching on evaluating of financial risks play an important role in promoting enterprise value and making enterprise develop healthily. At first the paper analyses and summarizes the current methods of evaluating financial risks, and then introduces the improved gray correlative analysis model to evaluate financial risks. At last, the paper verified the feasibility of the model in actual case. The improved gray correlative analysis can get the critical index of financial index system of enterprise and clarify the connect-degree between the critical financial index of enterprise and themselves. The paper put forward the suggestion that which financial index should be pay more attention to, and then analyze them pertinently according to the order of connect-degree. In the end, the paper give a prospect of how to evaluating financial risks.

articleTitle: The Study on Conduction Effect Assessment of Industrial Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Technological innovation is the cored power of national economic development. It is the conduction of technological innovation among industries that can promote implement of strategies of technological innovation, thus can it drive development of the whole national economcy. This paper concretely analyse the connotation of Conduction effect of industrial technological innovation and affect of different departments in the process of conduction of industrial technological innovation. And it analyses the total effect of conduction of industrial innovation of national 38 industries through using of principle component analysis method, and constructs comprehensive index system of evaluating industrial technological innovational conduction effect according to main potential influence factors. It is powerful supplement for assessment of industrial technological innovation through establishing assessment model and conduction effect assessment index system of industrial technological innovation, and it lays a strong foundation for assessing industrial technological innovation scientifically and objectively.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Product Development Effect Based on Rough Sets and Unascertained Number
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In market economy, a new product that enterprises develop has become very important factor of enterprises' continuous development and competition. In this paper, firstly, the indexes of evaluation of product development effect are reduced with Rough sets theory and main factors are obtained. Then a new evaluation method is proposed by analyzing evaluation problem of product development effect including the characteristics of uncertain information. Firstly, evaluation index system is established, and grading standards is put forward. Secondly, factor results and index weights are qualitatively described. Thirdly, the qualitative results are transformed to quantities value. Then unascertained number of factor results and index weights are established. Finally, using unascertained number algorithm, the result of evaluation is worked out. The method is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Study on the Industries Planning and Decision Method of Integration Economy Function Area
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper provides a new decision-making method for identifying core industries during the regional planning process of an integration economy function area. First, industrial clustering theory is used to understand the planned region within its larger geographic context. Second, a method of ranking the industries in the surrounding area is established and principle component analysis is used to confirm the core industries. Last, selection of the core industries for the planned region can be made in the context of its surrounding industries, planning requirements and its own competitive advantages. This is provides a convenient, specific and operative method in regional planning and also a quantitative and visual decision-making basis. At the same time, a new viewpoint from industrial clustering theory is provided for the theoretical research of regional planning.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution Chance and Mode of State-owned Forestry Enterprise Property Rights Institution
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: State-owned forestry enterprise comes from the planned economy founded in the early stage of founding of our country, and has played an important role in the specific history course, but present property rights problems of state-owned forestry enterprise is outstanding more and more, the evolution is imperative. Moreover the evolution chance and mode have important effect on the evolution. The article analyzes the evolution chance of state-owned forestry enterprise property rights institution, puts forward that the evolution of state-owned forestry enterprise property rights institution should start at the same time with the evolution of state-owned forestry resources property rights institution. On this base it clarifies that the evolution of state-owned forestry enterprise property rights institution has the characteristic of "forcible and gradual", and it should evolve combined with gradual mode through the government-leading compulsive evolution.

articleTitle: The Research of Dynamic Capabilities Theory and Logistic Enterprises' Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Recent years have witnessed a surge of interest in the notion of capabilities as an important source of competitive advantage. In this paper, we report an evaluation model for the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises based on the dynamic capabilities theory. We analyze the sources and methods of wealth creation and capture by logistic enterprises operating in environments for rapid technological change. We set up a competitiveness evaluation index system, employed SPSS statistical software, analyzed and compared the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises. Using a large sample of data from SSE and SZSE, we attempt to empirically study the importance of dynamic capabilities. The results and analyses were found to be useful for improving the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises.

articleTitle: Studies on the Mechanism of Service Innovation in the Network Alliance Based on the Knowledge Creation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: As a new kind of organizational forms -alliance network, the status of its service elements in the competition advantage and network value are being paid more and more attentions by academia and business circles. Service innovation is increasingly becoming a strong strength to promote alliance network development. In this paper, the relevant theories on knowledge creation, alliance network and service innovation are analyzed at first. On the basis of this, the relation model of between knowledge creation and service innovation is set up, and reveals the function mechanism of service innovation. Meanwhile, it puts forward to theoretical direction and research method for practice activity of alliance network.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on Dimensions of Work-Family Conflict
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, work-family issue has aroused attention in academic research and practice. After the literature review, this study has analyzed data obtained from a sample of 550 employees working in seven universities, and the research tries to examine the dimensions of work-family conflict in China through ANOVA. At last, some suggestions are given for further research in this field.

articleTitle: Integrated Evaluation Method and Application of Coordinated Development
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Coordinated development theory is the precondition and an important portion of sustainable development theory. In this paper, several works have been done as follows: (1) An improved integrated evaluation method based on coordinated development theory was discussed, and then we estimate the developmental status of system depending on this method. (2) Coordinated development space was defined and partitioned. During the process of partition, the evaluating indicator is classified by a threshold method which makes the variance between two groups is the maximum, and lower limit of development alpha was ascertained. (3) Coordinated development radius r were defined and gained by alpha , and coordinated development spaces were established based on r. (4) Considering the indicator of each evaluated objectives, they were distributed into relevant coordinated development space and those objectives in the same coordinated development space were sorted. The method discussed in this paper can offer the plain result for estimator in order to judge the coordinated development status of system, and to establish optimum strategy for various systems. An example is given to testify the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Study on Measuring of Gender Equity: A Survey Based on Family Planning Services at China's County-lever
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The standpoint of this paper lies in the study of family planning services at China's county-level. The hurdles that existed in mainstreaming gender equity in the family planning institutions indicate the needs for setting up a set of indicator system to measuring the gender equity. For this purpose, a literature review, experts' consultation, and field researches have been carried out to propose an operational conception of the gender equity in family planning/reproductive health services and to explore the dimensions of measuring the gender equity. On the basis of these work, a model to measure the dimensions of gender equity in family planning/reproductive health are proposed. The analysis of results indicates that the analytic model of evaluating system has three-degree, four-dimension with 16 indicators.

articleTitle: Risk Measurement Model and Empirical Study Based on VaR for Convertible Bond
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Convertible Bond is a financial derivative with characteristics of fixed income securities and equity securities. This paper analyzes the value of convertible bonds, and constructs the short-term investment risk model measuring the bonds with the method of Value at Risk. The greatest loss of Shuiyun convertible bond one day in the future is forecasted in the risk measurement model by collecting some continuous closing prices of the bond and the relevant stock, and the result is satisfactory with the error below 5 percent, which shows that the risk measurement model provided effective forecasting for decision making.

articleTitle: R&D Competition between Two Kinds of Corporations with Asymmetric Financing Ability
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Compared with multinational corporations, Chinese domestic corporations are faced with stronger financing constraints. This may weaken their capacities in engaging in R&D competitions. We build a dynamic game model to formalize this situation. Our results show that there is a R&D competition strategy for the multinational corporations, by which they engage in more aggressive product market competition by initiating a price war in the first period. This will decrease the domestic corporations' profit in the first period, make their financial signal worse, and therefore impose stronger financial constraints on the domestic corporations in the second period. This strategy can enlarge the advantage of the multinational corporations relative to the domestic corporations in R&D, and thus increase the probability that the multinational corporations monopolize the product market.

articleTitle: Study on the Dynamic Information Model for Civil Engineering Project Management Based on Data Grid Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The civil engineering project management can be regarded as a huge information system. All information existing during the project management process of the total lifecycle should be integrated in this system. The information variety during the project total lifecycle and they exist in different computer and different place. Considering the character of project management information, the article presents the dynamic information model for project management based on data grid technology. The information are classified and the information model expressed by mathematic formula and three-dimension graph that described the information and their relationship each other. At the different phase of project management of the total lifecycle, the share and discovery of project management information are researched with data grid technology. The information resources which are distributed geographically or different structure are integrated.

articleTitle: Application of Real Options to the Risk Management of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Risk management is very important to supply chain management. Managers can reduce supply chain risk by operations management and financial management. Many researchers studied the supply chain risk by using operations management, but only a few authors analyzed financial management applied to risk management of supply chain. Few researchers use the real options as a tool to study supply chain risk. In a supply chain, the right to return the unsalable products to the suppliers is a kind of option which is valuable. In this study, we add option to the normal order and try to manage the relationship between distributors and manufacturers with more flexibility. The rights of purchasing and the rights of returning the unsalable products to the supplier are two kinds of options. We choose a one-manufacturer n-distributor supply chain with a short life-cycle product to study. A mathematical model is developed for the manufacturer and distributor to make decision. Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate the decision. Numerical results are given. The novelty of the paper is that two kinds of options (call option of ordering products and put option of returning the unsalable products) are added to the model and Monte Carlo simulation are applied to simulate the order policy. The research will do some help to the manufacturer and the distributors for their production and distribution.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Supply Chain Channel Choice on the Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: There are many excellent features about drop-shipping. The focus of this paper is however on analyzing how drop-shipping will affect the supply chain members' payoffs, and hence their incentive to adopt drop-shipping. So, we are interested in finding answers to the following questions: How will supply chain members' payoffs be affected when moving from traditional channel to drop-shipping channel? Will anyone be worse or better off, or can everyone be better off? Under what conditions will they be worse or better off? We find the cases under which retailer and vendor both agree to adopt drop-shipping channel. Although drop-shipping requires transfer of demand uncertainty risk from retailer to vendor, changing the supply chain system from the traditional one to drop-shipping does not necessarily lead to a higher expected payoff for retailer and a lower one for vendor.

articleTitle: The EHR Systems in the Context of the Public Health Care Financing in the Russian Federation during Economy Transition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Today's milieu of healthcare information systems on the post-USSR territories is a loose alloy of the inherited pre-perestroika structures with the modern healthcare governance initiatives, against the background of the rapidly developing private sector in the medical IT-industry. By providing a general picture of the diverse infrastructure that the new IT-systems of today rely on for better care delivery, we have tried to outline and accentuate the following: a growing degree of awareness of the need to develop this sector, to eliminate the inefficiencies of the triple-channel system of care budgeting, with each of the three elements - the Social Insurance Fund, the Obligatory Insurance Fund, and the Pension Fund of the Russian Federation - often serving literally the same means, and the developmental context for the formation of a nation-wide system of the personal socio-medical records in the Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination with Multiple Competing Newsvendors
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: For a supply chain system with one supplier and multiple retailers who faces stochastic market demand, it can be coordinated with contracts (e.g., wholesale price contract, buy back contract, and revenue sharing contract). We find that wholesale price contract can coordinate the supply chain in the multiple newsvendors case and revenue sharing contract is equivalent to buy back contract in the newsvendors case with a fixed retail price. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the supply chain that experiences a demand disruption during the planning horizon. First, we show that the coordination may be broken off by an emergent event, which make the demand disruptions, that is, it makes the demand distribution different from the assumption needs to achieve original supply chain's coordination. Second, we show that changes to the original plan induced by an emergent event may impose considerable deviation costs throughout the system and make the supply chain uncoordinate. We derive conditions that indicate when the maximum profit can be achieved. Then, optimal strategies for supply chain to the disruptions by contracts are presented. Last, the adjusted contracts which have antidisruption ability are proposed, and they can be used as effective schemes to coordinate supply chain in a large range of situations.

articleTitle: Is Investment-Cash Flow Sensitivity Caused by Financing Constraints or Agency Conflicts? Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on a sample of Chinese listed companies, this paper explores the reasons for the relationship between cash flow and investment spending though examining the role of cash holdings on the investment-cash flow sensitivity. We find that the strong cash flow sensitivities of investment spending are indeed associated with companies' financing constraints or overinvestment of managerial discretions. The results suggest that the private enterprises and the large-sized local SOEs are more likely to over-invest, and higher levels of cash holdings play significant entrenchment effects and exacerbate the overinvestment behaviors of these companies. The results also imply that the small and medium-sized SOEs are suffered from financing constraints and their cash holdings act as a hedging device and mitigate the extent of financing constraints.

articleTitle: International Dependency and Economic Fluctuations in East Asian NIEs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the sources of economic fluctuations in the four Asian newly industrialized economies (NIEs), namely Hong Kong, Republic of Korea, Singapore and Taiwan. As small open economies, their macroeconomic development is highly dependent on technology as well as markets of large countries. Using the common trends model, we examine the impacts of external supply shock, internal supply shock and trade shock on the key national macroeconomic variables of these four economies, i.e. output, consumption, investment, export and import. The identification restrictions of the models are derived from the economic theory about the long-run relationships among the variables. The impact parameters are calculated from the common trends models and are used to analyze the influences of different shocks on the macroeconomic fluctuations. Our empirical evidence suggests that supply-side disturbances, both the country-specific supply shocks and international supply shocks explain the bulk of fluctuations in output.

articleTitle: Research on the Effects on Regional Economic Growth of Human Capital Inequality in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper has studied the effect on economic growth of human capital inequality and provided the measurement of stock and inequality of human capital. After calculating Gini coefficient and ratio of top quintile to bottom quintile (top<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>/bottom<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>) of human capital of each province (municipal or district) in China, considering other factors influencing economic growth, we use economic growth equation to examine whether human capital inequality significantly impact the economic growth. The result indicates that the top<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>/bottom<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> significant impact on regional economic growth, and some effect is indirectly brought through human capital accumulation. Whereafter, taking the data of 31 province (municipal or district) as 31 observations, make a Granger Causality Test between human capital inequality and human capital accumulation. The result indicates that the human capital inequality of neighboring province Granger cause human capital accumulation.

articleTitle: Dynamic Identifying Official Key Competences Based on Rough Sets and Information Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Analyzes the deficiency of conventional method of competence model establishment and introduces the rough sets theory and information entropy theory. On this basis, the dynamic identifying based on rough sets and information entropy for the official key competences is studied. An official competence measurement indicator system is established, by which the relations among competence dimensions and competence elements are analyzed. Rough sets and information entropy are taken appliance to attributes reduction and weight coefficients calculation. As a consequence, actual data of officials in politics and law department of certain city are taken as samples to demonstrate the model which is established in this paper. The result of demonstration illustrates the validity of the algorithm proposed and the practicability of the model.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordination Mechanism Model of the Three-level Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The research of the supply chain coordination mechanism is the hot research area, which is involved to study many independent entities, multistages, and various systems. The system effect of supply chain comes from the enterprises' sincere cooperation. The key issue of the supply chain coordination mechanism is to design a kind of contract to satisfy the so-called win-win condition between suppliers and demanders. We research the three-level supply chain which composing of a supplier, a manufacturer and a retailer by using game theory, operation research and related systematic optimization theories to build up it's benefit model. Based on the model, we contrast the optimal decision in the centralized-control system and decentralized-control system. And then, we design a revenue sharing contract and analyze the distribution of profit among the entities, the ranges of profit share parameters and how to determine the optimizing value. Finally, we give a numerical example to confirm coordination mechanism validity.

articleTitle: Effect on the Knowledge Transfer Performance from Knowledge Characteristics in Inter-enterprises Cooperative Innovation: Perspective of Knowledge Absorbing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge transfer is an important function of inter-enterprise cooperative innovation. The paper briefly divides the knowledge characteristics in cooperative innovation as tacit, simple embeddedness, deep embeddedness, modular and path dependence, and examines the effect on knowledge transfer performance from knowledge characteristics through positive studies. After the data and statistical analysis, the study indicate: tacit characteristic and simple embedded characteristic have significant negative correlation with knowledge transfer performance, modular and path dependence have positive correlation to knowledge transfer performance in some extent, and deep embedded characteristic does not has significant correlation to knowledge transfer performance. Meanwhile, it can be found that knowledge absorbing, including knowledge acquisition and knowledge application, plays the intermediary role between knowledge characteristics and knowledge transfer performance. Therefore, Chinese enterprises should pay more attentions to the Knowledge Characteristics in order to improve knowledge transfer in cooperative innovation.

articleTitle: Cluster and Discriminat Analyses of the Trade Protectionism
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Since every nation is residing in its own historic period, political and economic development level, different political groups have various political and economic pursuits. As a result, its foreign trade policies appear various characteristics. This paper analyzes the protectionism of the foreign trade policies of different countries by Cluster analysis and Discriminat analysis. Since it is the analysis of nation's classification, we use observation Clustering (Q Clustering). The data are indices which measure national protectionism from IMD World Competitiveness Yearbook (from2001 to 2005). We classify the protectionism policy in two different forms - the high protectionism and the low protectionism. ANOVA indicates the 5 variables (indices) in the Clustering analysis could better distinguish the difference among Clusters. Finally we constitute two suitable models to measure the trade policy mode of any country ( high or low protection ) by the two famous methods: Canonical Discriminat Function and Fisher's linear Discriminat functions.

articleTitle: Study on Web-based Team Knowledge Innovation Support System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge economy has brought enormous opportunities and challenges to Chinese enterprises. Effective knowledge management and knowledge innovation has become the key to enterprise survival and development in knowledge economy. However, at present the enterprises are lack of effective ways to support knowledge innovation, which results in such a disappointing situation that the employees' work enthusiasm and creativity are diminishing, particularly in the knowledge innovation team with high potential of creativity. In this paper, task oriented team knowledge innovation process is analyzed. Aiming at the team knowledge innovation process, the Web-based Team Knowledge Innovation Support System (TKISS) is proposed. The Key technologies of TKISS are studied. Moreover, this paper realized the prototype of TKISS. At last, TKISS is applied in an actual team knowledge innovation task.

articleTitle: Environmental Uncertainty, Discontinuous Innovation and New Venture Performance: An Exploratory Meta-study and Review
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the designs, methodologies and results of previous empirical research on discontinuous innovation of new ventures or new products quantitatively in condition of uncertainty. Three potential determinants of environment, strategies and capabilities to new venture performance or new product performance are identified through a meta-study of the aggregate data. Results suggest that such internal environmental uncertainty as organizational and resources uncertainty should be included in the discontinuous innovation oriented strategy of entrepreneurial firms and the numbers of related empirical studies be increased and measurement of performance also be added in more objective variables to improve the accuracy of research. Several implications and suggestions for future research are put forward based on the analytical results of 35 selected empirical studies.

articleTitle: Continuous Improvement Practices in Asian Developing Countries A Comparative Analysis between Chinese & Pakistani Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Pakistan and China both on industrial grounds have been engaged in following International Quality Standards to improve their products and services quality for their survival on both international and local trade. Both are neighbor developing countries and are struggling with the same aim of bringing continuous improvement in their processes and techniques. This paper is a comparative analysis of the continuous improvement practices/techniques carried out in manufacturing sector of these two countries. Here results have been derived from ISO 9001:2000 certified companies only. The sample size consists of 50 Pakistani and 45 Chinese companies of all levels. Questionnaire being used was identical. The prominent aspects being studied over here include difference of degree of practices of continuous improvement, motivational factors, barriers in successful implementation, and utilization of TQM tools. The results here would be helpful in knowing the trend and approaches of these two industries particularly ISO certified companies towards deployment of TQM.

articleTitle: An Interactive Integrated MCDM Based on FANN and Application in the Selection of Logistic Center Location
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Many practical problems are characterized as decision making with multiple, conflicting and noncommensurable nonlinear objectives and complex criteria. For identifying these nonlinear function structure and multiple attributes is a very difficult, time consuming, and confusing job in multiple criteria decision making (MCDM). This paper presents a feedforward artificial neural network (FANN) as a flexible and versatile approach for solving MCDM problems. In order to make the proposed ANN more adaptive to MCDM, this paper presents improvement methods to the FANN. Multicriteria hierarchy structure is established in an interactive method to determine appropriate network input-output structure. Fuzzy AHP is integrated with FANN. Criteria weights evaluated by Fuzzy AHP are used as ANN initial weights, which can make the FANN's weights get the definable meaning and avoid to be selected randomly. The method to standardize the criteria dimension can make the sigmoid activation function more efficient in ANN training. Arithmetic average function is applied to produce criteria value repeatedly to promise the generalization of ANN. We apply the proposed method to evaluate the location of logistic centers. The rank result indicates this model is a feasible and practical MCDM method which analyses both the qualitative and quantitative factors.

articleTitle: Formalized Research on Incompatibility Problems in Marketing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Business intelligence has become an important factor of the enterprise's core competence, most researches on business intelligence based on the analysis of data in order to get a result for decision-making. But there are many incompatibility problems in the real world can't be solved by current methods. In this paper, the structure, extension models, judging methods and solving methods of multi characteristic incompatibility problem are studied through establishing basic-element, extensible set and dependent function. The transformation solving incompatibility problem is called solution transformation. Taking the application in marketing as an example, the applied value of multi characteristic incompatibility problems solving will be explained. Its application in marketing shows that this study provides new tools for the intelligent disposal of contradiction problems.

articleTitle: Leadership Styles of World's most Admired Companies A Holistic Approach to Measuring Leadership Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The fundamental influence of leadership on several organizational outcomes, in spite of many empirical studies, has been only partially addressed mainly because no one of the existing models has so far found a fully convincing empirical evidence. In this paper we have identified ten fundamental instruments able to encompass the full complexity of the leadership role, considering also their situational impacts.
