abstract: In modern society, the measurement and evaluation of leader performance has been the important way of exploiting the core human resource. In former researches, leader performance evaluation mostly adopted ratio of total yearly increments to measure absolute progress effectiveness (APE). In this paper, leader behavior is not an abstract factor, which must be reflected on the dynamic change of leaders' performance. Relative progress effectiveness (RPE) of leader behavior performance can be measured by the method of data envelopment analysis (DEA), depending on two-time relative evaluations (TRE) and individual relative divergence (IRD), which really reflects the effective progress of individual behavior performance in leader team, and shows individual effective effort and utmost. Moreover its results will be beneficial to leader self-evaluation and self-development.

articleTitle: Dividend-price Ratio, Dividend Growth and the Future Returns
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper surveys the fields of relationship between the stock future returns and dividend yield. We studied if the dividend-price ratio can be used as a predictor of future returns. According to the accounting identity, we have an implication that the asset price should predict a discounted sum of future dividends and that the price-dividend ratio should predict a discounted sum of future changes in dividends. Since we can not find enough data in China Stock market for its short history, we use the dividend yields and stock returns from 1926 to 2004 on U.S stock market. We estimated the relationship of dividend-price ratio to the returns of different horizons, which are 1,2,3,4,5 and 10 years relatively with four models of stock returns and dividend-price ratio both in level and log forms. We find the dividend-price ratio explains better the returns as the return horizon gets longer. We also tested the relation between dividend-price ratio and dividend growth with different horizons and get the same results as the first above sho. Thus we conclude that across the long horizon the dividend growth and dividend-price ratio have a close correlation and the dividend-price ratio can be regarded as a good predictor of the stock future returns.

articleTitle: Game Analysis on the Exclusive Investment Tendency in China for Sino-foreign Joint Ventures & Implication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Starting with the elaboration of the phenomenon of the exclusive investment tendency in China for Sino-foreign Joint Ventures in recent years and the motives of the joint investment for the two parties at the initial stage, this paper gives brief induction to both parties' strengths and makes an analysis from two different stages on the game process of the joint ventures' changing from "Sino-foreign joint ventures" to "exclusively foreign-owned enterprises" by using the method of game theory, the results of which finds that the exclusive investment tendency is the investors' inevitable choice of their investment patterns based on the unbalanced development of both parties. At last part, the authors point out its negative effects as well as the implication to the developing host countries.

articleTitle: A Polynomial Time Algorithm for Coordination of Pricing and Lot Sizing Model with Backlogging
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In decentralized policy, lot sizing models with backlogging (LSP-B) tend to neglect the effects of market on production. In this paper, pricing is introduced into general LSP-B and by coordinating pricing and LSP-B, the rational price can be set such that the firm's profit is maximized. Demand is a deterministic function of price. It is primarily concerned that the same selling price on a product is maintained throughout horizon. An exact algorithm is developed to solve joint fixed pricing and LSP-B in polynomial time. The algorithm is based on alternate decisions on pricing and production. By restarting the alternate decisions repeatedly, the optimal pricing and corresponding production plan can be solved recursively. Results show that the joint policy may contribute more profit to the firm than the decentralized policy.

articleTitle: Early Warning System Research Based on Recognizing the Constraint in Road Traffic Safety
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problems of lacking of funds, limited national power, and the condition to be improved urgently of road traffic safety, the idea to establish the early warning system in road traffic safety by utilizing the theory of constraint is introduced. At first, the paper points out the coupling relations of the enterprise system and the road traffic system in three aspects, and affirm the probability of applying the constraint to the road traffic system; Secondly, the goal to make the safety economy effect maximization of road traffic system has been proved, and the base is established for recognizing the constraint by choosing the work indexes including reduced standard losses unit time, delayed traffic volume and operating expenses; Thirdly, the index, as describing the ability of road traffic, should be the traffic flow, which is used to recognize the constraint; fourthly, the early warning system based on recognizing the constraint in road traffic safety is established, which is composed of two subsystems of recognizing the constraint, constituting and actualizing the countermeasure; at last but not the least, we discuss the interrelated problems at present in the system by the difference between the early warning management system based on recognizing the constraint and the present management system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Model of Risk Sharing about Housing Pre-sale System in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The housing pre-sale system is an important financing mode to the real estate industry which is connected with long project cycle and plenty of capitals. In this paper, the essential questions in the housing pre-sale system in China is analysed, that is, it is only a unilateral risk sharing system. The institutional arrangement is not that let the relevant parties share the risks all together in the process of pre-sale, but that let only the bank and purchaser share it. Then, the optimal principle of risk sharing is studied by analyzing the type of risks and participants in housing pre-sale system. On the basis of the principle, the optimal risk sharing models of linear and nonlinear cases by the risk utility is set up. At last the application of the model is discussed to explain the difference of mechanism of risk sharing to all kinds of participants.

articleTitle: The Causes of Stock Market Volatility in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper developed and estimated a model which is capable of explaining movements in the conditional volatility of the Shanghai stock market. Among the most important determinants of the conditional volatility of the China stock market are found to be the conditional volatilities of industrial production and money supply which are directly associated with stock market volatility, and the interest rates, the import and the inflation which are indirectly associated with stock market. Among these variables the strongest effect is found to be from the money supply to the stock market in China.

articleTitle: Concept and Measurement of Dynamic Supply Chain Flexibility Based on the Shortest Lead-Time
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic supply chain flexibility theory is founded on the basis of concepts of flexibility of lead-time, response interval, the best flexibility of lead-time and the most efficient response interval. The flexibility couple is defined as the tensor of the best flexibility and the most efficient response interval. Flexibility couple is used to characterize and measure the capability of supply chain to cope with uncertainties. It has been elaborated that these concepts that are updated continuously in the process of accommodating environmental changes are dynamic. Delivery lead-time model of supply chain is developed, the model is applied to design the methods of flexibility measuring and prove that the best flexibility of supply chain is the maximum of that of all the suppliers and the most efficient response interval of supply chain is wider than that of all suppliers. Several examples are given to illustrate and validate the results.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis of Niche Structure of China Engineering Surveying and Design Enterprises Community
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The resource-partitioning phenomenon of engineering surveying and design enterprises on the mainland of China is studied with the method to compare and analyze variables of the niches. The research shows that the generalist engineering surveying and design enterprise occupies the dominant position in the resources of the community, but the occupancy ratio of its resources decreases with time. The specialist engineering surveying and design enterprise occupies the inferior position in the resources of the community, but its occupancy ratio of its resources increases with time. The current qualification administration is not only unfavorable to the growth of the specialist surveying and design enterprises, but also to the fostering of the large generalist surveying and design enterprises. The evolutionary law and the operation mechanism of the engineering surveying and designing enterprises community are expounded based on the resource-partitioning theory. It is suggested that the corresponding administrative system conducive to the forming of the rational niche structure for the enterprise community should be established.

articleTitle: Design of High-tech Enterprise Value Evaluating Measure System Grounded on Value Based Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Recently, many scholars have studied measure system of enterprise valuation, but the researches on the measure system of high-tech enterprise valuation are not too much and not perfect enough. But with the rise of high-tech industries and high-tech enterprises are attracting increasing attention. In this paper, the design of high-tech enterprise value evaluating measure system grounded on value based management, according to the characteristics of high-tech enterprises, takes increasing high-tech enterprise value as the final aim. It comprehensively considered following factors impact on high-tech enterprise value, namely current profitability, potential profitability and opportunity value of future industry. When we design and select evaluation measure, we start with tow aspects: the financial value drivers (that is, profitability indicators, financial status indicators, operating capacity indicators) and non-financial value drivers (that is, technological innovation capacity, integrated efficiency of human resources, risk factors, opportunity value of industry development, corporate governance structure). Here from we put forward the new ways how to research on the valuation of high-new-tech enterprise use ANP (analytic network process) model.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Optimal Strategic Analysis for a Monopolist Advertising and Pricing Based on Goodwill
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we extend the well-known Nerlove-Arrow dynamic model by adding both price and advertising, and study the dynamic optimal strategic pricing and advertising decisions of a monopolist, and obtain the following three main findings. First, a product's price higher than the myopic price on considering the price and advertising effects on goodwill. This result is consistent with the product differentiation policy that facilitates higher prices. Second, the ratio of goodwill to profit is directly proportional to the goodwill elasticity and inversely proportional to the sum of the marginal opportunity cost of investment. Third, if demand increases by more than the value of the new goodwill, then the firm should make profits through pricing and advertising based on cost considerations only. On the other hand, if the value of the new goodwill increases by more than the demand, then the firm should make profits from the goodwill improvements by advertising with a high goodwill.

articleTitle: Integrating Activity-Based Costing and Theory of Constraints for Making Product-mix Decisions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an ABC-TOC model to make optimal product-mix decisions based on the assumptions of static analysis and maximization of profitability. In this model, activity cost behavior is analyzed using ABC; the degree of control on activity capacity is set as an endogenetic variable; the impact of the opportunity costs of controllable activity capacity on decision is considered; relative constraints are identified by using TOC. A numerical study indicates that ABC-TOC model is a more general product-mix decision model. When the control degree on activity capacity is zero, the optimal product-mix derived from ABC-TOC model is the same as those from TOC. While full control on activity capacity and no opportunity costs, the optimal product-mix derived from ABC-TOC model is the same as those from ABC.

articleTitle: Un-equilibrium Research on Industry Agglomeration in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The scale of industry agglomeration has a right level. This text constructs an model based for 20 industries in China manufacture industry for the period 1999—2003, using LS estimation methods. The results indicate that China industry agglomeration level is un-equilibrium, and the actual industry agglomeration level is affected significantly by the initial industry agglomeration level and the long-run industry agglomeration level. The empirical model distinguishes long-run effects from initial effects and estimates the rate of adjustment when agglomeration deviates from its long-run equilibrium level. But the adjustment speed to the long-run seems to be faster in China than in most Western studies. The analytic results mean the difference in industry agglomeration level between the initial and the long-run will disappear average is 6.85 years.

articleTitle: Modeling and Application for Multiobjective Flow-shop Scheduling Using Hybrid Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Numerous real-world problems relating to flow-shop scheduling are characterized by combinatorially explosive alternatives as well as multiple conflicting objectives and are denoted as multiobjective combinatorial optimization problems. The problem of multiobjective optimization with setup times in flow shop is considered in this study. The objective function of the problem is minimization of the weighted sum of total completion time, makespan, maximum tardiness and maximum earliness. An integer programming model is developed for the problem which belongs to NP-hard class by using the hybrid genetic algorithm (HGA) to move from local optimal solution to near optimal solution for flow-shop scheduling problems. Small size problems and large size problems can be solved by the proposed integer programming model. Computational experiments are performed to illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed HGA algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of an EWMA Combining Technique to the Prediction of Stock Market Volatility
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Forecasting stock market volatility is an important and challenging task for both academic researchers and business practitioners. The recent trend to improve the prediction accuracy is to combine individual forecasts using a simple average or weighted average where the weight reflects the inverse of the prediction error In the existing combining methods, however, the errors between actual and predicted values are equally reflected in the weights regardless of the time order in a forecasting horizon. In this paper, we present a new approach where the forecasting results of Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedastic (GARCH), stochastic volatility (SV), and random walk models are combined based on a weight that reflects the inverse of the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of each individual prediction model. The results of an empirical study indicate that the proposed method has a better accuracy than the GARCH, SV, and random walk models, and also combining methods based on using the MAPE for the weight.

articleTitle: Multivariate Cointegration Analysis of the Relationship between Electricity Consumption and Economic Growth in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Many scholars research deeply the relationship between the electricity consumption and GDP. In my view, the composing factors of GDP impact on the electricity consumption in different ways, so the relationship between the electricity consumption and the composing factors of GDP is studied in the paper. Electricity consumption is chosen as the explained variable, and Fixed asset investment, disposal income per capita, export, and electricity power price are chosen as the explanatory variables, twenty-five years (from 1980 to 2004) real data of all the variables (deducted the influence of inflation) in China are taken as the samples. Based on the unit root test and cointegration test, the model is found to analyze the cointegration relationship between the explained variable and explanatory variables, and it is suitable to forecast the electricity demand in long-term. Owing to the existence of equilibrium mechanism, the error correction model is applied to analyze the degree that the short-term electricity consumption deviate the long-term equilibrium state.

articleTitle: Controlling Balance of Multiple Large Shareholders of China's Listed Corporations in Pyramidal Ownership
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper empirically investigates the impact of control contestability among multiple large shareholders in the ultimate controlling shareholders' dominant control ownership. The paper's new findings show that when the separation of cash-flow and voting rights of the ultimate controlling shareholder (CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub>/V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub>) is higher, multiple large shareholders have more incentives and ability to monitor the ultimate controlling shareholder, which has a positive effect on the operating performance, when CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub>/V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">u</sub> is lower, there is more argy-bargy between the ultimate controlling shareholder and other large shareholders, which destroys the operating performance. When the identity types of multiple large shareholders are different, the monitoring incentive of other large shareholders on the ultimate controlling shareholder surpasses the coalition incentive, which has a positive effect on the operating performance.

articleTitle: Product Innovational Strategy and Cooperation in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The paper presents the results of an empirical study that aims to investigate the impact of inter-firm cooperation over innovation on product innovation in China. Drawing on the innovative milieu literature, the impact on the product innovation was tested in three different ownership structures: state-owned concentration, non-state-owned concentration, and non-state-owned decentralization. Three models were run by using a unique data come from Chinese listed corporations in five hi-innovation industries. The main findings of the paper seem to provide substantial evidence that state-owned firms' capacity to product innovation could greatly improve if they cooperated with other firms. However, for non-state-owned decentralization corporations, cooperation is not a good way to product innovation. Therefore, innovation policy should not overlook the ownership component of innovation corporations and ought to initiate and support inter-firm cooperation selectively.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Animal Husbandry Industrialization Development of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Heilongjiang is a big province in animal husbandry, but at present the superior advantage in animal husbandry has not been formed. The reason that the economic advantages cannot be fully displayed mainly lies in that the animal husbandry industrialization has not been formed yet. Based on scientific nature, the rationality, the systematic and the practical principle, and combined with the operating characteristics and nature of animal husbandry, the evaluation system of animal husbandry industrialization is established, and according to this, the animal husbandry industrialization of Heilongjiang Province is evaluated, countermeasures of Heilongjiang animal husbandry industrialization development are proposed.

articleTitle: The Study of Economic Incentive Policy for Building Energy Efficiency of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The study of economic incentive policy is of great significances for Beijing to implement building energy efficiency work by taking good advantage of various economic levers. With the development of Beijing's economy, energy consumptions are increasing dramatically and energy shortage has become a critical factor that influences future development of the city. Implementing building energy efficiency can effectively reduce energy demand and bring great environmental and social benefits. This paper analyzes present situation of building energy efficiency work in Beijing, appraises present situation for drafting economic incentive policy, puts forward economic incentive policy configuration according to different types of buildings and does feasibility research for the policy in order to supply theoretical support for certain authorities to draft proper economic incentive policy for building energy in Beijing.

articleTitle: Impact on the Results of ARCH Models with Different Distribution of the Residuals - Based on Comparative Analysis of Shanghai Stock Market Index Returns
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper uses ARCH models to analyze Shanghai stock market index returns from 19 December 1990 to 30 November 2006, and compares the results of ARCH models with normal distribution and t distribution, finding that the results are very different. The conclusion is that the reasonable results of ARCH models are determined by selecting appropriate distribution of the residuals. T distribution is better suited to fitting the distribution of the residuals than normal distribution. The ARCH effect exists in Shanghai stock market. The leverage effect is significant, and the impact of negative news in the stock market is larger than positive news. Fluctuations caused by impact will be permanent, and can not be eliminated in a short time. The phenomenon of high returns with high risks does not exist in the market.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Cumulative Model of Competitive Priorities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The competitive advantage of the manufacturers mainly roots in the manufacture and competitive priorities are important means to gain competitive advantage. Based on the competitive priorities theory of the manufacturing strategy, this paper analyzes the five competitive priorities in the manufacturing enterprises with the data come from the International Manufacturing Strategy Survey (IMSS). The factor analysis, correlation analysis and multiple regression analysis are made. This paper concludes that: (1) There are mainly positive correlations among the main elements of the competitive priorities. (2) The descending importance order of them is quality, delivery, cost, flexibility, and innovation. This order is consistent with the traditional cumulative model, which proves that the relationships among the competitive priorities are cumulative and the cumulative model exists in the manufacturing. The conclusion provides valuable ideas for manufacturing to create competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The Analysis of RMB Real Exchange Rate Asymmetric Volatility Impact on Foreign-Invested Enterprises Export and Import in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper estimates the impact of asymmetric RMB exchange rate volatility on the foreign-invested enterprises (FIEs) export and import. The volatility is measured by the conditional variance of RMB real effective exchange rate index from a threshold autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity model. Using Engle-Granger co-integration method, this paper shows that the volatility of RMB exchange rate impacts FIEs export and import negatively in the long-run, which impacts FIEs export more severely. In short run, exchange rate volatility impacts FIEs export negatively, but impacts FIEs import positively. In conclusion, it is advisable to expand the RMB exchange rate floating range gradually by the Chinese government.

articleTitle: An Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm Applied to the Price Structure Optimization of the Bankcard Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The price structure of the bankcard network is vital in deciding the prosperity of the bankcard transaction market. In order to obtain the optimal price structure of the bankcard network, a constraint optimization model is constructed and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced and improved by adding a perturbation factor, adopting double fitness value and keeping some unsuitable solutions near the boundary. By applying the improved PSO algorithm, the optimal solution is given and the policy implication is provided to promote the development of the bankcard network. Simultaneously, the improved PSO algorithm is proved to be an effective and efficient way to solve the constraint optimal problems.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Improvement of Resources Allocation Efficiency in Regional Innovation System Based on DEA-benchmarking Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Regional innovation system is a vital component of the national innovation system, as well as the base of the development of the regional economy. At present, the shortage of human resources and financial resources is the main obstruction for the improvement of the innovative capacity of the regional innovation system. Meanwhile, the structure of both inputs and outputs of regional innovation system gradually becomes a vital factor influencing the improvement of resources allocation efficiency. Due to certain constrains of macroeconomic factors, the shortage of the human resources and financial resources can not be met in a short period. Consequently, strategy of resources allocation improvement, analyzed by the view of the structure of the inputs and the outputs of regional innovation system, is a very heated topic, influencing both the innovative efforts of the firms and the sustainable development of the regional economy. The paper analyzes the structure of the inputs and outputs by the method of exploratory factor analysis firstly, and then evaluates the resources allocation efficiency of regional innovation system from 1995 to 2004 by utilizing the data envelopment analysis benchmarking method. Based on the empirical results, the paper proposes three strategies to improve resources allocation efficiency of regional innovation system: firstly, the structure of the inputs and outputs should be given more attentions. The increase of resources inputs alone cannot get expected outputs, but decrease resources allocation efficiency of RIS if adjustment of the inputs' structure is ignored; secondly, the amount of the financial inputs should be determined according to the stock of the human resources; Thirdly, the policy-maker should consider which stage regional innovation system is in. Precisely, the enhancement of commercialization of S&T, the increase of S&T outputs and the improvement of quality of the S&T outputs should be, in order, the main focus to improve resources allocation efficiency, according to the stage of thedevelopment of the regional innovation system.

articleTitle: The Interface Integration of Cooperative Technology Innovation under Network Circumstance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The cooperative technology innovation is newly characterized by high speed of information flow, wide scope for choosing partners, little limitation to geo-locality, etc. Based on the model of the interface integration of technological innovation by Vandevelde and others, this paper adds some new variables that influence the cooperative technology innovation under network circumstance, and constructs a new model for the cooperative technology innovation interface management and for the organization integration of innovation occurrence, which improves the original model and applies a cooperative technology innovation case to test the model.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination under E-procurement Auction
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an online auction with buyback contracts to coordinate supply chains under the circumstance of E-procurement auctions. We show that traditional catalog auctions generally cannot coordinate supply chains because the bidding mechanism distorts the wholesale price decisions and results in a lower order quantity than that optimal for the whole supply chain. The proposed buyback auction can not only benefit the retailer with a low wholesale price as catalog auctions, but also benefit him with the supply-chain-wide optimal order quantity and a buyback price higher than her salvage price. And we show that the supplier-chosen-rule in the proposed buyback auction is also simple to apply like in the catalog auction. Decisions of the suppliers and the retailer in the buyback auction are analyzed and illustrated with numerical examples.

articleTitle: Effect of Energy-environmental Policies on Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to discuss the innovation incentives and welfare effect of different and composite energy-environmental policies on technology innovation. The paper starts from the dynamics of technology innovation stressing the influence of governmental regulations. A model is developed to analyze the effects of emissions tax, auctioned permits and direct command and control regulation particularly. The supply side of the innovation market is incorporated in the model. Results show that the combination of direct command and control regulation and market-oriented policy is effective in the short run. The analysis also indicates that sometimes the direct command and control are rational options given the condition that quick and temporary policy adjustment is required for certain emergent cases. Future policy implications in China are also discussed.

articleTitle: Enterprise Cooperative Innovation Game Analysis on Duopoly Market Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the rapid changes in information technology, the unstoppable economical globalization and the in-depth development of the network economy, the market competition rules, the uncertainty of running the enterprise, as well as the enterprise traditional antagonism competition have undergone tremendous changes. Under the new economic condition, the enterprises can not simply depend upon their own strength to meet the market needs. They must adopt the cooperation innovation developmental strategy. There is the very strong conjunction nature between the cooperation game theory based on the collective rationality supposition and the enterprise cooperation innovation developmental strategy. More and more scholars interest in the research of cooperative innovation based on the cooperative game theory. This paper constructs a two-stage dynamic duopoly game model of enterprise cooperative innovation based on the existence of technological spillover, analyses equilibrium input, equilibrium output and benefit assignment in the different cooperative innovation degree, and provides the theory basis and the foundation for the enterprise cooperative innovation policy-making.

articleTitle: Based on SERVQUAL Instrument Explore a New Method for Service Quality Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: All the time, as a service quality measurement method SERVQUAL is often recommended in classic textbooks, or cited by many literatures. But there always be some papers persisting that SERVQUAL instrument is not a good method to service quality measurement because of the problems of reliability, discriminant validity, spurious correlations, and variance restriction etc. Considering SERVQUAL is a good instrument for service quality problems diagnosis, and for the above issues, we attempt to improve the SERVQUAL instrument from three facets, that is, choosing the operational definition of expectation; importing self-confidence to expectation in service quality measurement; and adopting the formative service quality measurement model. Finally we test the modified gap measurement method empirically in 2006 Shenyang International Horticultural Exposition (EXPO).

articleTitle: Impact of Game Type on Supply Chain Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the impacts of asymmetric-information game and stochastic- information game on supply chain performance. A two-stage supply chain consisting of a manufacturer and a retailer is considered and four types of games are compared: symmetric-deterministic game, symmetric-stochastic game, asymmetric-deterministic game and asymmetric-stochastic game. This paper shows that information uncertainty affects the supply chain by changing the retailer's equilibrium, whereas information asymmetry affects the supply chain by changing the manufacturer's equilibrium. And in the practical supply chain, information uncertainty is likely to undermine supply chain performance greater than information asymmetry. Numerical simulations show that an asymmetric-stochastic game is not equivalent to an asymmetric game plus a stochastic game. Under certain conditions, the impacts of information asymmetry and information uncertainly will interact, which will result in greater impact on supply chain performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationships among Entrepreneur Traits, Goal Orientation and New Venture Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Entrepreneur traits have been long recognized as an important factor which impact new venture performance. This study divides entrepreneur traits into three dimensions, risk-taking propensity, need for achievement, locus of control, analyzes the direct impact of entrepreneur traits on new venture performance. And based on this research, we bring in the entrepreneurial goal orientation as moderating factor, and analyze the indirect roles. The results suggest that the relationship between risk-taking propensity and new venture performance is an cap-shape, and need for achievement and internal locus of control are positive and significant to the new venture performance by entrepreneurial goal orientation.

articleTitle: A Method of Modeling and Solution Based on Non-zero-sum Cooperative and Dynamic Games for Nodal Enterprises in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Based on some features of supply chain, game theory is utilized to analyze the behaviors of nodal enterprises in supply chain, the results of analysis show that the process of games among nodal enterprises belongs to non-zero-sum cooperative games, dynamic games and incomplete information games. Then, for the nodal enterprises in supply chain, the model of non-zero-sum cooperative and dynamic games is established. Furthermore, the core method is improved by introducing a subsidy variable. Solution of model by applying the improved core method and the Shapley value method combined with cooperative game theory is used as the criterion of payoff allocation for nodal enterprises. Finally, researching potentials and suggestions about supply chain coordination and incentive are proposed. The work of this paper provides the theory basis and the direction of further research for the coordination mechanism and the incentive mechanism among nodal enterprises.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship between Housing Price Bubbles and Urban Growth
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The continuous and prompt rising of commercial housing sale price in many Chinese cities since 2003 caused a broad controversy on whether there exists a bubble in Chinese real estate market. Shanghai is a most disputable urban on bubble issue. According to the price bubble theory, the existence of a bubble can be interpreted from abnormal interactions between housing prices and market fundamentals. This paper conducts an empirical analysis on the causality between urban housing price and urban fundamental factors in Shanghai through econometrics models including unit root test, Granger causality test. Urban fundamental factors reflect market basis of housing price resulting from urban growth. They are urban residents' disposable income and urban population growth rate. These variables are time series from 1994 to 2005. The result indicates that urban population growth and income don't Granger cause housing price. In other words, the present housing price in Shanghai overruns the urban growth fundamentals. Therefore, there is a price bubble in Shanghai real estate market.

articleTitle: Study on Application of Game Theory to Tax Levy and Administration of Head - Branch Organization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With the development of market economy, more and more enterprises set up branch organization outside the head organization in order to expand operation and strengthen competition ability. But the operation model of head-branch organization is a complex participating system. This increased the difficulty of its tax levy and administration. So, basing on the visual angle of game theory, this paper analyzed the behavior of levy and ratepaying as well as their game relationship existing in tax levy and administration of head-branch organization from the aspect of levy and administration part along with taxpayer part emphatically. Furthermore, this paper put forward specific tentative plans to improve them, which are perfecting the game rules, accelerating the construction of information network, enlarging the force of supervision, establishing stimulation and restraint mechanism, strengthening the guarantee system.

articleTitle: Research on Methods of Reverse Logistic Vendor Selection under Closed-Loop Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The ever-increased environmental pressure and ever-limited resource encourage people to consider Closed-Loop Supply Chain (CLSC), which deal with integrating product returns into the total supply chain picture over the lifecycle of the product, thereby recovering a maximum amount of value. However, as for the key enterprise of every closed-loop supply chain, the importance of reverse logistic vendor is incontrovertible. After the review of connected literatures in recent years, combined with the characteristics of the relationship between key enterprise and reverse logistic vendor, relying on the synthesis of theoretical analysis and statistical test, integrated model which is the Analytical Hierarchical Process (AHP) method based on the data processing of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is put forward. Finally, Empirical study is given to test the feasibility of the new model (DEA-AHP) produced in this paper.

articleTitle: Empirical Research Based on Structural Equation Model for Competitiveness Evaluation of Listed Corporations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with the essential features of corporation competence, Structural Equation Model (for SEM) and Grey System, and analyzes the feasibility of evaluating corporation competence by combining SEM with Grey System. From the need of research approach and research objective, this paper refers to present correlated research findings and statistics from 350 listed companies of manufacturing companies in 2005 annual report, and one inchoative model and three comparative models ( that is, M2, M3, M4) are built to evaluate corporation competence, SEM is applied to conduct confirmatory factor analysis (for CFA). A desirable model is determined by analyzing and comparing the parameter estimates and fit index in four models built, and Grey System is adopted to evaluate corporation competence of listed companies.

articleTitle: Bric Countries: Chalanges of Decade
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper we would like to focus on four emerging economies as drivers of globalisation: Brazil, Russia, India and China, the so-called BRICs economies. We analyze political, economic, social and technological criteria of BRIC countries development, using PEST method.

articleTitle: Study on the Product Diffusion of Monopoly Industry Based on Logistic Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In reality, most market structures are monopoly competition or oligarch monopoly. There must be the loss of efficient only if the imperfect competitive markets exist. Consequently, the quality of product or service will decrease, and the promotion of product and service will be blocked. The open of the world products and service market and the competition will comply with the market principles in the process of deregulation. So it is important to explore the development of monopoly industry from the view of product diffusion. This article according to "S" type of technology popularization route and the characteristic of monopoly industry analyzes and predicts the product diffusion of monopoly industry. Firstly, introducing logistic increase model; Secondly, analyzing relevant parameter in the model combining the characteristic of imperfect competition of monopoly industry, and describing the process of product popularization of monopoly industry. Finally, indicating that marketing strategy of China mobile communications industry at the present stage and making estimate to the development tendency of mobile users in China.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation of Port Based on the Multi-instance Kernel K-aggregate Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The analyses of the port data show us that the traditional data lay-out and the exited clustering algorithms could not be used in the port customer segmentation, so this thesis presents a new three-level data bag by combined with the way in which the multi-instance learning treat the data. Then a multi-instance kernel function is constructed according to the new bag. When the distance between two mixed valued vectors is counted the information gains are imported to weight the different attributes. The partition coefficient and average fuzzy entropy are calculated to decide the best cluster number of the clustering algorithm. Finally the kernel k-aggregate clustering algorithm using the multi-instance kernel is applied to the customer segmentation and gets a good clustering result which provides the managers guidance and evidence of different marketing strategies for corresponding subdivided markets.

articleTitle: The Research on the Pricing System of Mobile Value-added Service for 3G
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Lots of facts prove that the technique advantage does not mean the market advantage. Therefore we should pay more attention to the market strategies rather than the blind expansion on 3G network .To the moment that the 3G license will be issued in China soon, market strategy on 3G pricing system should be taken as one of important studies. Based on the theory of surplus value, this paper raises a settlement standard calculation model for operators and SP (service provider) to improve the pricing system of mobile value-added services. This paper is organized as follows, firstly, it defines the conception of mobile value-added service and the research area of the pricing system; secondly it analysis the existing pricing system, and illustrates one-part pricing system which takes content-based charging would greatly facilitate the development of value-added service in the age of 3G (3rd generation, international mobile telecommunications-2000); Finally it states settlement standard calculation model for operators and SP based on the theory of surplus value for implementing the pricing system of one-part pricing system which takes content-based charging.

articleTitle: Competition and the Reform of Incentive Schemes in the Regulated Electricity Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In the incentive regulation to the transmission and distribution enterprises, the application of performance based yardstick competition introduces competition to this natural monopoly field. Due to the existence of competition regulator is able to observe some information which are related to the cost style of enterprise to a certain extend. Because those information reduce the asymmetry of information between regulator and enterprises, it make regulator to change his incentive regulation and affect the power of incentives to the enterprises. In this paper, we get some conclusion as fellow. The information's effect to the power of incentives may be positive or negative. If the equality of information is good enough, the power of incentives to the active enterprises increases, if not, the power of incentives is ambiguous, even decreases. For the regulator, carrying out yardstick competition is one of good ways to gain useful information and then can help regulator implement reform in regulated sector.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Supply Chain Competitiveness Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: With business management mode changing from a single company to a network company, market competition has been no longer a firm versus a firm but rather a supply chain versus a supply chain. Thus, the following questions naturally rise. What about the competitiveness of a supply chain? How does a supply chain win another one? What market share can a winning supply chain gain? They have attracted the attentions of numerous researchers and are also the focus of this paper, which tries to answer the questions by evaluating supply chain competitiveness from the perspective of game theory. This paper proposes that supply chain competitiveness is determined by supply chain information, supply chain strategy and supply chain payoff collectively. It sets up a system of evaluating indicators and evaluates the competitiveness synthetically. To demonstrate the application of the evaluation method introduced in the paper, lots of firms of Guangdong Province are studied and five supply chains are chosen to be evaluated with their competitiveness. The results provide some guidelines for decision makers to improve the supply chain competitiveness and gain much more market shares.

articleTitle: Effect of Pay Strategy on Employees' Pay Satisfaction: Testing and Modifying the Equity Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Although pay strategy is an important aspect in organizational strategic management, its effect on employees' pay satisfaction is unclear yet. In This paper, the effect of pay strategy on employees' pay satisfaction was examined by a simulative experiment, which was based on the Adams' equity theory. 122 MBA students participated in the study, and a single-factor completely randomized design was employed. The results indicated that pay strategy has significant effect on employees' pay satisfaction: market lead strategy resulted in positive reaction on pay satisfaction, but significantly only when participants' pay was much better than referents; pay lag strategy resulted in dramatic negative reaction on pay satisfaction. The conclusion is that employees were more sensitive for market lag strategy than market lead strategy, and equity theory was unsuitable for the situations of market lead strategy. Based on the results, the theoretical contribution and practical implication of this study were discussed finally.

articleTitle: Study on Improved DEA-Based MPI and Its Application in Dynamic Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Malmquist productivity index (MPI) has been applied to express the dynamic performance over time, which can provide valuable information about the effectiveness of an industry. However, there exist scarcities about multiple correlation problems of variables and limitation of relationship between Decision Making Units (DMU) and input/output indexes. In this paper, a modification approach of DEA-Based MPI is proposed by using principal components analysis (PCA) and other relevant ways. A real data set about ten container ports in China over the period of 2001 to 2005 has been used to validate the method proposed in this paper. It is necessary to adopt effective policies and measures to improve the performance of productivity and competitiveness of this industry, and to promote the sustainable development of container accumulation ability of hinterland in different regions. The improved DEA-based MPI approach provides a practical tool to assist policies design and make strategic decisions for ameliorating the total performance in many fields.

articleTitle: Identifying the Divergence of a Given Alternative for Consensus Process in Group Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: On the understanding that the weight of decision-makers is unchangeable, the theoretical framework of this research is put forward. This article starts from constructing consensus degree model and group's difference coefficient (GDC), then analyzes the function of GDC on the mediation mechanism for consensus process, and proposes that identifying the group divergence in evaluating given alternative is the key element of research. In the light of alliance enterprises, this article not only proves that identifying evaluation divergence of a given alternative in mediating consensus process is effective, but also reaches some valuable conclusion. The conclusions are obtained by the models calculated from actual alliance enterprises, which includes: firstly, the 6 members delegating alliance enterprises differ in evaluation of the initial alternatives; secondly, GDC makes divergence degree between group's evaluation of a given alternative and of other alternatives clear; finally, GDC not only provides a basis for adjusting consensus process mediation mechanism alternatives, but also directs participants in full discussion.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>

articleTitle: Contractor Project Risk Evaluation Based on Expansion Principle for Triangular Fuzzy Matrix
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The risks factor of construction projects are made an analysis on the characteristic of project, thus the international project risk evaluation system has been built based on the six risks that include bidding risk, market competition risk, engineering characteristics risk, contract risk, other participator risks and environmental risk. Construction of the project risk evaluation system has been established, and complementary judgment matrix is designed based on triangular fuzzy number. Furthermore triangular fuzzy matrix has been made a solution by expansion principle from the multi-attribute-based, priorities of complementary judgment matrices are provided. The result realize for identifying the pivotal risk factor of construction project risk.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Value Chain Theory Jungle in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to classify and comb the theories and concepts which were derived from or related to value chain theory, and further to explore the developing status and evolutionary rules of these theories in China, some research work on the value chain theory jungle was presented. After giving the definition and component structure of this theory jungle, hierarchical models of the two main theory trees were put forward. Based on the data collected by utilizing information retrieval platform and search engines, contrast analysis on the theories or concepts in each tree was carried out and the evolutionary rules of value chain theory jungle in China are eventually acquired. All the work in this paper can provide an adequate review of past work and serve as a guide to future research for the scholars working in this area as well.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Value-Creating Ability of EVA-Based Investment Banks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The ultimate aim of investment banks is to optimize the allocation of capital and resources through capital market and create new value. Practices have shown that any economic activity is a process in pursuit of value creation and value-added, and so are investment banks. Economic value added (EVA), a new indicator set up by American Stern & Stewart in the 1980s to weigh value-creating ability, is now already applied by western financial circles to different degree. The empirical research of the value-creating ability of China's investment banks by means of EVA has shown that the whole value-creating ability of China's investment banks is still low. In the future, China's investment banks should seek different value added channels in the five-level value-added chain.

articleTitle: Study on A New Premium Principle and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Insurance pricing is usually based on classical risk theory which has some uncertain factors because of the disunity to risk pricing and arbitrage-free pricing approach is used widely in financial market. This paper attempts to solve the insurance pricing problem through the financial arbitrage-free pricing method due to the increasing interconnection between insurance and financial market. The risk-neutral probability measure is introduced to establish a new arbitrage-free premium pricing principle in the incomplete insurance market by selecting the risk-neutral probability measure with minimum cross-entropy optimization model. This model is very flexible because of the form of risk-neutral constraints are variable. Moreover, if the constraints are linear in the model, the solution of the optimization model is easily obtained. Meanwhile, the form of insurance pricing is certain. It is showed that the impartiality of this premium principle agrees well with arbitrage-free.

articleTitle: The Economic Climate Index with Asymmetric Feature in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Economic climate index is widely used to depict the macroeconomic running station. In the modern methods to construct the composite index, dynamic factor model is the most influential one. Considering the structural change in business cycle's upward and downward phases, the mathematical models constructed to compute the climate index monitoring the business cycles should involve the Markov switching mechanism which is used to describe the asymmetric features in business cycles. This paper will introduce the dynamic factor model with Markov switching and try to construct the macroeconomic climate index with asymmetric feature through this model. The result of this paper shows that the business cycle of the new expansion stage in China, contrast to the contraction stage, has the characteristics of longer expansion duration and smaller amplitude.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Competition between Interconnected B2B Marketplaces Based on Two-sided Market Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: According to traditional theory of network effect, B2B marketplaces in e-commerce should be considerably concentrated or even the whole B2B industry would be monopolized by one firm because the most powerful marketplace will attract almost the market participants. However, in reality in many types of electronic marketplaces there generally exist different firms in size. To correctly explain this phenomenon is the purpose of our paper. According to emerging two-sided market theory, B2B marketplace is a typical two-sided market. We develop an asymmetric Cournot duopoly competition model on open electronic B2B network based on two-sided market theory. It is shown that there exists a great scope such that asymmetric interior unique Nash equilibrium could hold, which means that market concentration doesn't prevail in B2B e-marketplace. In addition, when a firm improves more quality of its product or service relative to other firm, it could earn more profit.

articleTitle: The Appraisal of Independent Innovative Capacity of Enterprises in Our Country Based on Gray Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Enterprise is the main body of Independent Innovation, the nucleus power and dependence of the development of science and technology, and it is also the material base which realizes the scientific and technological progress of our country. Firstly, the thesis makes a generalization of the current independent innovative capacity of enterprises in our country. On the basis of this, according to the principle of the appraisal of innovative capacity, the thesis designs the system of appraisable indexes. Then, taking 14 typical enterprises as the sample, the thesis makes an objective and quantitative analysis of independent innovation by use of the Grey Clustering Analysis method. Finally, the thesis obtains the outcome of gray analysis, and makes an inductive analysis to the appraisable outcome.

articleTitle: Research on Pricing-Inventory Models for New Products under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Abstract: The authors build pricing-inventory models for a new product including multiple fuzzy parameters based on credibility programming under fuzzy resource constraints in accordance with integration idea and design a hybrid intelligent algorithm (HIA) to determine the combined pricing and inventory decisions. Furthermore, considering enterprises usually develop set of products, this paper extends the previous model for a new product to that for two new products situations and builds pricing-inventory model for two new products based on credibility programming, where the relation of the two new products, such as complementary, substitute, and independence, is considered.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Transfer and Sharing of the Core Process within Knowledge-Intensive Organizations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Knowledge-intensive organizations operating in today's modern business environments face several kinds of challenges brought by their ways of operating and the characteristics in their business environments. The objective of this paper is to discuss the key elements that should be considered when identifying core businesses process within knowledge-intensive organizations. After talking about how to distinguish the core process from the multitudinous business processes, this paper gives a method based on business process to acquire knowledge. This paper explores the key factors that have been cited as significant influences on the ability to transfer and share knowledge. This will be accomplished by first identifying the factors that may cause problems for core process. And then offers transfer and sharing.

articleTitle: Price Decision in a Custom-made Product Supply Chain with Remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider reverse supply chain and traditional supply chain synchronously, combining mass customization with recovering of old products. A custom-made production can be divided into two stages. The first stage is common parts production and the second stage is individual production. We make process as nonlinear bilevel programming problem by two cases: manufacturer callback and retailer callback. Firstly, we study a supply chain with one manufacturer and one retailer, then extend these models with n competing retailers. Solving these problems, we can get optimal wholesale prices , retail prices, callback rate and exchange prices of callback product made the profit of retailers and manufacturer maximize. We analyze and compare two cases and extended model through numerical example. We find that increasing the rate of recovery and introduction of competition are good ideas to improve profit.

articleTitle: Goal Programming in Quality Function Deployment Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: Quality function deployment (QFD) is a systematic approach that captures customer requirements and translates them, through house of quality (HOQ), into technical characteristics of the product. An important activity in constructing a HOQ is to determine improvement ratios for the technical characteristics, based on the collected customer requirements, with a view to achieving a high level of overall customer satisfaction. Traditional methods for this planning process are mainly subjective, and often result in a non-optimal or sub-optimal solution, especially with many customer requirements and technical characteristics. This paper presents a goal programming approach to QFD planning. We first present a generic goal programming model for QFD. We then propose a genetic algorithm for linear and nonlinear goal programming models in QFD. Computational experiments show that the proposed approach is effective.

articleTitle: Automatic Thesaurus Generation and Its Weight Assignment for External Information Support in GSS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: External information plays an important role in group decision making process, and technology advancement in recent year has made the research of external information support in GSS feasible. Thesaurus generation and its weight assignment is a critical part of external information support system, for it serves as a bridge connecting GSS meeting and external information support system. This paper firstly introduces the argumentation information model and its related concept. Based on this model, section 3 proposes an automatic thesaurus generation method consist of three steps: word segmentation, primary terms recognition and stopping. In section 4, we developed a methodology of weight assignment and illustrate some typical heuristic rules as well as their application environment.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Online Infomediary Based on Extension of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM2)
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper identifies factors determining the use of online infomediary and its effects on information search. Extension of the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM2) is used as the main framework and combines with asset specificity and risk awareness as another two factors. Consumers tend to use two-stage processes to reach their purchase decisions, first screening of available products and then in-depth comparison of selected products. This paper explores the acceptance on online infomediary by Chinese web surfers in these stages. Using survey data from 300 university students, the authors test the proposed model through structural equation modeling (SEM). Findings reveal that the TAM2 model is applicable to both stages. Besides, risk awareness is not applicable to the initial screening stage, and asset specificity has positive influence to perceived usefulness of online infomediary.

Author Keywords: extension of the technology acceptance model (TAM2)

articleTitle: Calculating Total Cycle Time of Supply Chain Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: After time-based competition was put forward in 1988, total cycle time has long been recognized as an important metric for assessing the performance and competitiveness of a supply chain. Total cycle time management paradigm of supply chain is a managerial philosophy. Total cycle time management seeks to reduce total time required to perform all the activities that occur in the entire supply chain. Goods flow process in supply chain is analyzed, finding that it has the Markov property. In this paper, a Markov chain model is developed for calculating and managing the total cycle time of supply chain. It can identify the activities that represent the largest components of total cycle time. Those activities are then targeted for cycle time reduction. Furthermore, an example was given, and finally observations are made.

articleTitle: An Empirical Test of Balassa-Samuelson Hypothesis:Some Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: It is a remarkable topic at all times whether the Balassa-Samuelson hypothesis, hold for real exchange rate in transition countries, but it doesn't become the focus in China until recently we start to test whether it is suitable for Renminbi exchange rate. In view of the fact that the pressure of Renminbi's revaluation grows gradually, as well as the PPP has a inclination of deviating from the equilibrium exchange rate in the long run, this paper takes a further examination and analysis of the Balassa-Samuelson hypothesis, based on other economists' former research, in aim to providing a useful angle for the observation of Renminbi exchange rate's trend. So we use our nation's empirical data from 1980 to 2005 to test this model by OLS in two periods which is divided at 1994. Our empirical results show that after the reformation the Renminbi exchange rate's trend display a strong positive correlation with the relative price level in sample period.

articleTitle: Asymmetry of Return Distribution, Abnormality of Intradaily Risk Based on Quantile Regression Model with High-frequency Data from Shanghai Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: In finance and econometrics, study on high-frequency time series data has attracted plenty of attentions in recent years. The high-frequency time series data do help to investigate the micro structure theory of financial market more closely, and the need of modeling high-frequency data for risk management has already risen greatly in practice. In the paper, the quantile regression model with ARCH effect, as an ideal semi-parametric approach to estimate the quantile of return distribution directly that differs from the conventional mean-variance framework in risk management and econometrics, is applied to analyze the 5-minute high-frequency intradaily return and trading volume time series of Shanghai Composite Index in Shanghai stock market of China. We find that the significant asymmetry of return distribution and negative relationship between price change and first-order lagged trading volume, and that value at risk analysis and back testing also indicate quantile regression model is a competitive method to risk management in high-frequency data conditions. Finally the abnormality of intradaily risk pattern near opening and closing is also discovered.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Spatial Distribution and Evolution of FDI in Mainland China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: There are certain rules about the spatial distribution of foreign direct investment FDI, among them region agglomeration is the main characteristic. Based on the theory of spatial econometrics, present paper uses GIS software to research the spatial distribution of FDI. Moran's I statistics, spatial Gini indices, and global Theil indices of 31 provincial areas in mainland China, are calculated. Then, an exploratory spatial data analysis is conducted to analysis the evolution process from the spatial aspect in order to diagnose and estimate the spatial difference and dynamic disequilibrium by building spatial econometrics model of FDI in mainland China. The results reveal that GDP and cumulated FDI are very important to attract FDI, and LISA cluster map provides an easy way to recognize the core of clusters.

articleTitle: The Research on Wasp Agent-based Resource Allocation for Distributed and Autonomous Manufacturing Entities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Management Science and Engineering
abstract: The network organization paradigm is gaining a growing importance in manufacturing as an instrument to help companies face the rapid challenges from market. In this paper, we view the node of network organization as autonomous manufacturing entities from different organization. We focus specially on the problem of resource allocation for the autonomous manufacturing entities to best satisfy order demands. We adopt a new approach which is influenced directly from computational model of how wasp colonies allocate tasks to meet the collective needs of the nest. firstly, our system models each entity in the network organization as a wasp agent and each task as a zone in wasp nest. Secondly, we propose a mechanism of resource allocation and design a method of threshold values updating considering an entity's capability. Finally, we construct XML-based information communication format between wasp agent and its entity.
